# Feature Engineering and Selection


## 1\. Library Import and Data Loading


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(caret)
library(FSelector)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
```

```{r load_data}
df_clean <- read.csv("df_clean.csv") %>% clean_names()

cat("Loaded df_clean. Rows:", nrow(df_clean), "Cols:", ncol(df_clean), "\n")
```

-----

# 2\. Feature Engineering

We create new categorical groupings for better model performance and encode variables for use in feature selection.

## 2.1 Domain Grouping


```{r}
df_long_domain <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(domain = str_split(domain, ",\\s*")) %>%
  unnest(domain)

df_enc_domain <- df_long_domain %>%
  mutate(domain_grouped = case_when(
    domain %in% c("Language") ~ "Language",
    domain %in% c("Speech", "Audio") ~ "Speech & Audio",
    domain %in% c("Vision", "Image generation", "Video", "3D modeling") ~ "Vision & Media",
    domain %in% c("Biology", "Medicine", "Materials science", "Earth science", 
                  "Astronomy", "Mathematics", "Psychology") ~ "Science",
    domain %in% c("Robotics", "Games", "Driving", "Cybersecurity", 
                  "Search", "Recommendation") ~ "Technology",
    domain %in% c("Multimodal") ~ "Multimodal",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

df_regrouped_domain <- df_enc_domain %>%
  distinct(model, domain_grouped) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(domain_grouped = paste(unique(domain_grouped), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()

df_enc <- df_clean %>%
  select(-domain) %>%
  left_join(df_regrouped_domain, by = "model") %>%
  # If a model falls into multiple domains, classify it as 'Multimodal'
  mutate(domain_grouped = if_else(str_detect(domain_grouped, ","), 
                                  "Multimodal", domain_grouped))
```

## 2.2 Country to Continent Mapping


```{r}
country_to_continent <- data.frame(
  Country = c(
    "Canada", "Korea (Republic of)", "Switzerland", "Germany", "United States of America",
    "Multinational", "Ireland", "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland", "Brazil",
    "China", "United Arab Emirates", "India", "Belgium", "France", "Spain", "Netherlands",
    "Singapore", "Poland", "Hong Kong", "Macao", "Italy", "Russia", "Israel", "Finland",
    "Australia", "Sweden", "Japan", "Austria", "Greece", "Vietnam", "Portugal", "Taiwan",
    "Lebanon", "Thailand", "Indonesia", "Saudi Arabia", "Iceland", "Denmark", "Croatia", "Lithuania"
  ),
  Continent = c(
    "North America", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "North America",
    "Multiple", "Europe", "Europe", "South America",
    "Asia", "Asia", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe",
    "Asia", "Europe", "Asia", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "Asia", "Europe",
    "Oceania", "Europe", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "Asia", "Europe", "Asia",
    "Asia","Asia", "Asia", "Asia", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe", "Europe"
  )
)

df_long_country <- df_enc %>%
  mutate(country = str_split(country_of_organization, ",\\s*")) %>%
  mutate(country = lapply(country, unique)) %>%
  unnest(country) %>%
  mutate(country = str_trim(country),
         country_std = country)

df_long_country <- df_long_country %>%
  left_join(country_to_continent, by = c("country_std" = "Country"))

df_regrouped_continent <- df_long_country %>%
  distinct(model, Continent) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(continent = paste(unique(Continent), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()

df_enc <- df_enc %>%
  left_join(df_regrouped_continent, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(continent = if_else(str_detect(continent, ","), "Multiple", continent))
```

## 2.3 Organization Category Grouping


```{r}
df_long_orgcategory <- df_enc %>%
  mutate(organization_categorization =
           str_split(organization_categorization, ",\\s*")) %>%
  unnest(organization_categorization)

df_enc_orgcategory <- df_long_orgcategory %>%
  mutate(category_grouped = case_when(
    organization_categorization == "Industry" ~ "Industry",
    organization_categorization == "Government" ~ "Government",
    organization_categorization %in% c("Academia", "Research collective") ~ "Academia/Research",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

df_regrouped_category <- df_enc_orgcategory %>%
  distinct(model, category_grouped) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(category_grouped = paste(unique(category_grouped), collapse = ", ")) %>%
  ungroup()

df_enc <- df_enc %>%
  select(-organization_categorization) %>%
  left_join(df_regrouped_category, by = "model") %>%
  mutate(category_grouped =
           if_else(str_detect(category_grouped, ","), "Multicategory", category_grouped))

df_enc %>%
  count(category_grouped, sort = TRUE)
```

## 2.4 Model Accessibility and Numeric Encoding


```{r}
df_enc <- df_enc %>%
  mutate(
    model_accessibility_grouped = case_when(
      model_accessibility == "Unreleased" ~ "Unreleased",
      model_accessibility %in% c("API access", "Hosted access (no API)") ~ "Limited (hosted/API)",
      model_accessibility %in% c("Open weights (non-commercial)",
                                 "Open weights (restricted use)") ~ "Open (restricted)",
      model_accessibility == "Open weights (unrestricted)" ~ "Open (unrestricted)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-model_accessibility)

df_enc$model_accessibility_grouped <- factor(
  df_enc$model_accessibility_grouped,
  levels = c("Unreleased", "Limited (hosted/API)", "Open (restricted)",
             "Open (unrestricted)"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

df_enc$access_numeric <- as.numeric(df_enc$model_accessibility_grouped)
```

## 2.5 Confidence Encoding

```{r}
df_enc$confidence <- factor(
  df_enc$confidence,
  levels = c("Unknown", "Speculative", "Likely", "Confident"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

df_enc$confidence_numeric <- as.numeric(df_enc$confidence)
```

## 2.6 Collaboration Complexity


```{r}
df_enc <- df_enc %>%
  mutate(
    n_org = str_count(organization, ",") + 1,
    collaboration_complexity = case_when(
      n_org == 1 ~ "Single-actor",
      n_org == 2 ~ "Dual-actor",
      n_org >= 3 ~ "Multi-actor"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-n_org)
```

## 2.7 Days Since First Date Publication


```{r}
df_enc$publication_date <- as.Date(df_enc$publication_date)

df_enc$days_since_first <- as.numeric(
  df_enc$publication_date - min(df_enc$publication_date, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```

# 3\. Feature Selection using Recursive Feature Elimination

## 3.1 Recursive Feature Elimination

```{r}
feature_groups <- list(
  access = c("access_numeric", "model_accessibility_grouped"),
  conf   = c("confidence", "confidence_numeric")
)

combo_grid <- expand.grid(
  access = feature_groups$access,
  conf   = feature_groups$conf,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

generate_dataset <- function(access_var, conf_var) {
  df_enc %>%
    select(
      domain_grouped, continent, country_of_organization,
      category_grouped, organization,
      all_of(access_var),
      collaboration_complexity,
      num_authors, days_since_first, parameters,
      all_of(conf_var),
      training_power_draw_w
    ) %>%
    rename(
      access_final = all_of(access_var),
      conf_final   = all_of(conf_var)
    )
}

datasets <- pmap(combo_grid, ~ generate_dataset(..1, ..2))
names(datasets) <- apply(combo_grid, 1, paste, collapse = "_")
```

```{r}
run_rfe <- function(df, name) {
  df_fs <- df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
    drop_na(training_power_draw_w)
  
  control <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs, method = "cv", number = 5)
  
  set.seed(123)
  rfe_fit <- rfe(
    x = df_fs %>% select(-country_of_organization, -organization, -training_power_draw_w),
    y = df_fs$training_power_draw_w,
    sizes = c(3, 5, 7, 10, 13),
    rfeControl = control
  )
  
  rmse_val <- min(rfe_fit$results$RMSE)
  rf_model <- rfe_fit$fit
  
  importance_all <- varImp(rf_model)
  importance_opt <- importance_all$importance[rownames(importance_all$importance) %in% rfe_fit$optVariables, , drop = FALSE]
  
  list(
    name = name,
    rfe = rfe_fit,
    rmse = rmse_val,
    importance = importance_opt
  )
}

results <- imap(datasets, ~ run_rfe(.x, .y))
```

## 3.2 RFE Performance Comparison


```{r}
rmse_table <- map_df(results, ~ tibble(
  version = .x$name,
  min_cv_rmse = .x$rmse
))

print(rmse_table)

rmse_table_all <- map_df(results, function(res) {
  tibble(
    version = res$name,
    size = res$rfe$results$Variables,
    RMSE = res$rfe$results$RMSE
  )
})

print(rmse_table_all)
```


```{r}
rmse_table_all <- rmse_table_all %>%
  mutate(version = factor(version))

ggplot(rmse_table_all, aes(x = size, y = RMSE, color = version, group = version)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(rmse_table_all$size)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "RFE: RMSE vs Subset Size for all dataset versions",
    x = "Number of Features in Subset",
    y = "CV RMSE"
  )
```


## 3.3 Final Feature Selection and Save


```{r}
df_fs_final <- df_enc %>%
  select(
    domain_grouped, continent, category_grouped,
    access_numeric, 
    collaboration_complexity,
    num_authors, days_since_first, parameters,
    confidence_numeric, 
    training_power_draw_w
  ) %>%
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) %>%
  drop_na(training_power_draw_w)

control <- rfeControl(functions = rfFuncs, method = "cv", number = 5)
set.seed(123)
rfe_fit_final <- rfe(
  x = df_fs_final %>% select(-training_power_draw_w),
  y = df_fs_final$training_power_draw_w,
  sizes = c(3, 5, 7, 9), 
  rfeControl = control
)

plot(rfe_fit_final, type = c("g", "o"), main = "Final RFE Curve")

rf_model <- rfe_fit_final$fit
importance <- varImp(rf_model)
print(importance)

selected_vars <- predictors(rfe_fit_final)
```

```{r}
df_selected <- df_fs_final %>%
  select(all_of(selected_vars), training_power_draw_w)

write.csv(df_selected, "df_selected.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved df_selected.\n")

df_final_all <- df_enc %>%
  select(
    domain_grouped, continent, category_grouped,
    access_numeric, 
    collaboration_complexity,
    num_authors, days_since_first, parameters,
    confidence_numeric, 
    training_power_draw_w
  )

write.csv(df_final_all, "df_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved df_final.\n")
```
